notes: SPEPEToken has no constructor arguments and mints all 1,000,000,000 SPEPE with 18 decimals (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units) to msg.sender once at deployment. Supply is fixed, with no subsequent minting, burn, owner, admin, proxy or upgrade functions. Transfers from the fixed Uniswap v4 PoolManager 0x8366a39cc670b4001a1121b8f6a443a643e40951 to any other address send a 2% tax, rounded down as floor(amount/50), to the fixed tax wallet 0x3d6a89c8751a45dd577a4c1f3b34e71c58236193; the remaining amount goes to the recipient. This rule also applies to liquidity withdrawals. Transfers to the PoolManager, including sells, pool seeds and manager self-transfers, are untaxed. Wallet-to-wallet transfers and ordinary distributor claims are untaxed. The tax rate and both addresses are constants. Launch allocations are handled by the factory outside the token. There are no application contracts to deploy. initialPrice records the requested provenance value; the deployer derives the opening price from economics and the deployed currency order.
